content:
Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) stock trades at 28.9 times earnings, compared with 22.9 for the S&P 500, a price at which buyers appear to expect its growth to last . Before paying that price, you want to know what you own, and the company’s priorities have changed. During its fiscal Q3 2024 call, management said it expected sustained revenue growth in cystic fibrosis (CF) over the short, medium and long term. The latest call still called CF a franchise with sustained growth, but it spent more time on what comes after CF. So what is management making the case for now?

Vertex Now Talks Up Medicines Beyond Cystic Fibrosis

During its fiscal Q2 2026 call in August, management said the emerging renal franchise could one day rival CF in revenue. Executives also made the case for an agreement to acquire Crinetics for about $8.8 billion, net of the cash it acquires. That deal, management said, would add a fifth pillar in rare endocrine diseases.

That shift matters because CF still accounts for most of Vertex. TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO, the company’s main CF medicine, generated 85.9% of company revenue in fiscal 2025 . Growth for the treatment slowed to 0.7% that year, down from 14.5% in fiscal 2024.

So far, CF as a whole is still growing. Global CF revenue rose 11% from a year earlier in fiscal Q2 2026. Management said strong uptake of ALYFTREK, its newer CF medicine, led the volume growth in the U.S.

When Vertex Pharmaceuticals is a large share of what you own, what its management stops saying matters more. See how to protect a concentrated position .

How Big Are CASGEVY And JOURNAVX So Far?

CASGEVY and JOURNAVX, the two newer medicines Vertex already sells outside of CF, combined to bring in $126 million of the $3.33 billion the company reported for fiscal Q2 2026. Both treatments are growing fast. CASGEVY, a one-time gene therapy for sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia, generated $76 million, up about 75% from the prior quarter. JOURNAVX, a pain medicine, earned $50 million, up about 70% on the same basis.

For 2026, management expects $500 million or more from its non-CF products, compared with total revenue guidance of $13.1 billion to $13.2 billion. The larger bets sit further out. Management estimates peak sales of the two lead Crinetics medicines, PALSONIFY and atumelnant, at about $5 billion, and expects the deal to add to non-GAAP operating income in 2029.

Is Vertex’s Wider Focus Good News For Holders?

So far, the shift looks more reassuring than worrying, because CF continues to grow while the newer medicines build. Yet part of the 11% growth in CF came from factors that may not repeat. Outside the U.S., management said CF growth came partly from the timing of orders and currency movements. The company added that quarterly revenue received a lift from sales channels restocking after running down in the first quarter.

If CF growth fades, the newer medicines remain too small to fill the gap in 2026. The renal franchise has not yet launched. The FDA set November 30, 2026 as its decision date for povetacicept, the medicine Vertex has built a renal commercial team to launch.

Right now, CF is still growing. Management said it was very confident of reaching its 2026 goal for the newer medicines, which remain the smaller part of the business. Vertex held its third-quarter call in early November in each of the last two years, a timing that would provide an initial read. When the company reports on or around February 10, 2027, the number to watch is full-year revenue from its non-CF products, measured against the $500 million or more management expects.

Is Too Much Of Your Wealth Riding On One Stock?

What Vertex Pharmaceuticals’ management talks about has changed, and holders are left to work out why. chineseContent:
Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) 股票的市盈率为 28.9 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.9 倍，买家似乎预计该公司的增长将持续下去。在支付这个价格之前，你想知道你拥有什么，并且公司的优先事项已经改变。在 2024 年第三季度财报电话会议上，管理层表示，预计囊性纤维化 (CF) 业务的收入在短期、中期和长期内持续增长。最新的电话会议仍然称《CF》是一款持续增长的系列，但它花了更多的时间讨论《CF》之后的内容。那么管理层现在的理由是什么？

Vertex 现在谈论囊性纤维化以外的药物

在 8 月份的 2026 年第二季度财年电话会议上，管理层表示，新兴的肾脏特许经营权有一天可能会在收入方面与 CF 相媲美。高管们还提出了以约 88 亿美元（扣除所收购现金）收购 Crinetics 的协议。管理层表示，这项交易将在罕见内分泌疾病领域增加第五个支柱。

这种转变很重要，因为 CF 仍然占 Vertex 的大部分。该公司的主要 CF 药物 TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO 在 2025 财年创造了公司收入的 85.9%。该疗法的增长率当年放缓至 0.7%，低于 2024 财年的 14.5%。

到目前为止，CF整体仍在增长。 2026 财年第二季度，全球 CF 收入同比增长 11%。管理层表示，其新型 CF 药物 ALYFTREK 的强劲应用带动了美国销量的增长。

当福泰制药 (Vertex Pharmaceuticals) 拥有您所拥有的大部分股份时，其管理层不再表态的内容就更为重要。看看如何保护集中位置。

CASGEVY 和 JOURNAVX 到目前为止有多大？

Vertex 已经在 CF 之外销售的两种新药 CASGEVY 和 JOURNAVX，在该公司报告的 2026 财年第二季度的 33.3 亿美元收入中合计带来了 1.26 亿美元收入。这两种治疗药物都在快速增长。 CASGEVY 是一种治疗镰状细胞病和 β 地中海贫血的一次性基因疗法，营收 7600 万美元，比上一季度增长约 75%。 JOURNAVX 是一种止痛药，收入为 5000 万美元，同比增长约 70%。

管理层预计 2026 年非 CF 产品收入将达到 5 亿美元或更多，而总收入指导为 131 亿至 132 亿美元。更大的赌注坐得更远。管理层估计 Crinetics 的两种主要药物 PALSONIFY 和 atumelnant 的峰值销售额约为 50 亿美元，并预计该交易将增加 2029 年的非 GAAP 营业收入。

Vertex 更广泛的关注对持有者来说是个好消息吗？

到目前为止，这种转变看起来更让人放心而不是令人担忧，因为随着新药的不断开发，CF 仍在继续增长。然而，CF 11% 的增长部分来自于可能不会重复的因素。在美国以外，管理层表示，CF 的增长部分来自订单时机和汇率变动。该公司补充称，季度收入在第一季度下滑后，因销售渠道补货而有所提振。

如果 CF 增长减退，新药的规模仍然太小，无法填补 2026 年的空白。肾病专营权尚未推出。 FDA 将 2026 年 11 月 30 日定为 povetacicept 的决定日期，Vertex 已建立了一个肾脏商业团队来推出该药物。

目前，CF仍在增长。管理层表示，对于实现新药 2026 年的目标非常有信心，新药仍占业务的较小部分。 Vertex 过去两年每年都在 11 月初召开第三季度电话会议，这个时间可以提供初步的了解。当该公司在 2027 年 2 月 10 日左右发布报告时，值得关注的数字是其非 CF 产品的全年收入，以管理层预期的 5 亿美元或更多为衡量标准。

您的财富是否过多集中在一只股票上？

Vertex Pharmaceuticals 管理层谈论的内容已经改变，持有人需要找出原因。当一个头寸增长到你财富的很大一部分时，急剧下跌可能会损害你的整个计划，而出售以分散资金可能会带来巨额税单。我们的合作伙伴咨询公司提供免费的策略审查，以评估保护集中头寸并以更少的税收解除头寸的方法。
